description: Backend core: remove IntaSend, comment out Daraja STK Push, add migration for manual payment columns (mpesa_code, admin_note, verified_by, verified_at, pending_verification status), rewrite BookingController::store() and ClinicBookingController::pay() to accept mpesa_code and return pending_verification status, add BookingController::paymentStatus() polling endpoint, create ManualPaymentController with index/verify/reject, create PaymentRejected notification.
steps: In app/Http/Controllers/BookingController.php: remove 'use App\Services\IntaSendService;' import, remove 'protected IntaSendService $intaSend' constructor param, remove the entire airtel/card IntaSend block, comment out the entire M-Pesa STK Push block with /* */. Remove DarajaService from constructor. Keep BookingService injection only.

In app/Http/Controllers/ClinicBookingController.php: remove IntaSendService use/import/property/constructor-param, comment out the Daraja STK Push block, remove DarajaService constructor injection. Constructor becomes empty.
In routes/api.php: remove 'use App\Http\Controllers\IntaSendWebhookController;' and the intasend.webhook route. Leave IMBank routes.
In .env: comment out INTASEND_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, INTASEND_SECRET_KEY, INTASEND_ENVIRONMENT with leading #
In bootstrap/app.php: remove 'api/intasend/webhook' from the validateCsrfTokens except array

Create database/migrations/2026_11_12_000001_add_manual_payment_fields_to_payments_table.php: add string mpesa_code nullable after mpesa_receipt; text admin_note nullable; foreignId verified_by nullable constrained users nullOnDelete; timestamp verified_at nullable. In a separate DB::statement alter the status enum to include 'pending_verification'.
Update app/Models/Payment.php: add mpesa_code, admin_note, verified_by, verified_at to $fillable. Add verifiedBy() belongsTo relationship.

Rewrite BookingController::store() paid section: validate mpesa_code required string min:6 max:30, create Payment with status=pending_verification and mpesa_code, return JSON {status: 'pending_verification', booking_id, booking_uuid, payment_id, message}. Remove DarajaService and IntaSendService from constructor entirely.
Add BookingController::paymentStatus() method as specified in plan section 4.
Rewrite ClinicBookingController::pay() as specified in plan section 5: validate mpesa_code, create Payment with status=pending_verification, redirect to clinic.my-bookings with info flash.
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ManualPaymentController.php with index(), verify(), reject(), confirmRelatedBooking() private, confirmRelatedClinic() private as specified in plan section 6.
Create app/Notifications/PaymentRejected.php following BookingConfirmedStudent pattern, as specified in plan section 7.
In routes/web.php: add GET /bookings/payment-status route BEFORE the /bookings/{booking} route. Add admin manual-payments routes inside the admin middleware group.
acceptance_criteria: php artisan migrate completes without error
php artisan route:list --name=admin.manual includes admin.manual-payments, admin.manual-payments.verify, admin.manual-payments.reject
php artisan optimize:clear reports no missing class errors
No reference to IntaSendService in any controller (only the deleted files themselves)
POST /bookings with mpesa_code returns JSON with status=pending_verification
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Migration ran cleanly adding mpesa_code, admin_note, verified_by, verified_at columns and extending the status enum with 'pending_verification'. IntaSendService and IntaSendWebhookController deleted. BookingController and ClinicBookingController constructors now take only BookingService (clinic controller is empty constructor). paymentStatus() route is registered at GET /bookings/payment-status BEFORE the {booking} wildcard route. Admin routes admin.manual-payments, admin.manual-payments.verify, admin.manual-payments.reject all registered. Admin view at resources/views/pages/admin/manual-payments.blade.php created with Alpine x-data accordion for verify/reject inline forms. Next FEATs (FEAT-002 and FEAT-003) should implement: (a) tutors/show.blade.php wizard update — replace processPayment JS, add mpesaCode Alpine property, add pending-verification Step 3 UI; (b) clinic-checkout.blade.php payment section replacement; (c) admin nav update in layouts/admin.blade.php to add Manual Payments link. The ClinicEnrollmentConfirmed notification is called in confirmRelatedClinic() — verify it exists before FEAT-002 or add a guard. The paymentPending() method still exists in ClinicBookingController and the clinic.payment-pending route still exists in web.php — they are harmless but can be removed in a future cleanup. DarajaService is still registered in the app but is NOT injected anywhere now, keeping it available for future re-enablement as intended by the spec.
